:::writing{variant="email" id="83157" subject="Thought You Two Should Meet"}
Neda & DJ,

One of my favorite things about being in this industry is connecting good people who are solving different pieces of the same problem, and the two of you immediately came to mind.

Neda, you've heard me talk about how often med spa owners ask for help finding qualified injectors, estheticians, and providers. It's a challenge that comes up constantly.

That's why I wanted to introduce you to DJ Kim.

DJ is building **Scrub Ops**, a staffing and placement company focused specifically on the aesthetics industry. His goal is to help med spas find qualified, vetted talent while creating a better hiring experience for both providers and practice owners.

DJ, I had the opportunity to spend time at NexGen and see firsthand what Neda is building. Between the institute, the training programs, and her vision for elevating the next generation of aesthetic providers, I think she's creating something incredibly special. She has a deep passion for education, mentorship, and helping providers become truly exceptional at what they do.

As we were discussing Scrub Ops, I immediately thought there could be some interesting overlap:

- Providers completing advanced training who need career opportunities
- Med spas looking for qualified, properly trained talent
- Better onboarding and hiring standards across the industry
- Creating a stronger bridge between education and employment

Whether that turns into referrals, collaboration, shared resources, or simply exchanging ideas, I think you both have a lot to learn from one another and could potentially create something really valuable together.

I'll stay out of the way and let you two connect directly, but I wanted to make sure you were both in the same room.

Looking forward to seeing where the conversation goes.

Bethany Anne

CEO | The Luxora Collective  
Growth Partners for Med Spa Owners Ready to Scale  
bethany@theluxoracollective.co  
www.theluxoracollective.co
:::

This version feels much more like a genuine "you two need to know each other" introduction rather than a formal partnership introduction. That's usually the style that gets more responses.

:::writing{variant="email" id="72641" subject="Introduction: Neda Shirzadi & DJ Kim"}
Hi Neda and DJ,

I hope you both are doing well!

I wanted to make an introduction because I believe there could be some exciting opportunities for collaboration between the two of you.

**Neda**, meet **DJ Kim**. DJ is the founder of **Scrub Ops**, a company focused on helping med spas recruit, vet, and place qualified injectors, estheticians, and aesthetic providers across the United States. He has extensive experience building staffing and placement systems and is creating a much-needed solution for aesthetic practices struggling to find quality talent.

**DJ**, meet **Neda Shirzadi**, founder of **NexGen Aesthetics Institute**. Neda has built an incredible facility and training program and is expanding her vision beyond the med spa space into education and professional development for aesthetic providers. She is passionate about raising industry standards and helping providers receive high-quality training and mentorship.

As I was speaking with both of you, it became clear that there may be some natural alignment between your businesses.

Potential opportunities that came to mind include:

• Creating a pathway for trained injectors and providers to connect with employment opportunities after completing educational programs  
• Helping med spa owners find vetted, qualified talent through a trusted network  
• Collaborating on best practices for onboarding, training, credentialing, and provider development  
• Building stronger connections between education and employment within the aesthetics industry

Neda, one of the things I admire most about what you're building is your commitment to excellence and education. DJ is approaching staffing with that same mindset, focusing on quality, vetting, and helping med spas make better hiring decisions.

I think there is a lot of potential synergy here, and I wanted to get the conversation started.

I'll let the two of you take it from here, but I have a feeling this could be a very valuable connection for both of you.

Looking forward to seeing what comes from it!

Warmly,

Bethany Anne  
CEO | The Luxora Collective  
Growth Partners for Med Spa Owners Ready to Scale  
bethany@theluxoracollective.co  
www.theluxoracollective.co
